title: The Hadoop ecosystem: YARN, Hive and HBase

videos.script: Hadoop is not one program. It is a filesystem, a cluster manager, a programming model, and twenty projects that grew around them. {{stack}} This lesson runs the three a data engineer still meets. YARN, which hands out the machines. Lesson four's streaming job runs on it, and so does Spark, with its driver inside the cluster. {{yarn}} Two queues share the cluster seventy and thirty, and the analysts get their share while the nightly load is running. {{queues}} Hive's metastore, which turns directories into tables with names, partitions and statistics, the catalogue every engine still speaks to. {{hive}} And HBase, a database on HDFS that finds one visitor's events at once, and takes fifteen seconds to count them all. {{hbase}}
